artifacts_to_persist: All verified raw source shards in the data-root cache, including original annotation payloads without semantic decoding.
Private per-document input-length/source-identity/component ledgers, per-shard custody/schema and metadata-only result report.
Failed attempts and protocol amendments retained with clear lineage.
controls: No Torch/model import/forward; no weights, source loader code execution, paid requests, auth token discovery or implicit credential use.
Anonymous official HF endpoint with token=False and Xet disabled; pinned exact revisions, file sizes and raw SHA256 independently checked before decoding and after read.
Parquet projection guard rejects any columns other than the exact ID/document-input whitelist; one-row batches, no source questions/annotations printed or decoded.
Private source/cache/census under the data root; metadata-only stdout/repo. Existing source-native labels remain untouched in immutable raw blobs.
Committed code/protocol/helper and primary rights/metadata/tokenizer fingerprints before source download.
Retain incomplete/failed attempts without overwriting; no count-based endpoint/gate changes.

correctness_amendment.fix: Collapse duplicate leading path slashes for route dispatch only. Preserve raw source URL, native title/text, byte identities, labels, source allocation, all7830rows, thresholds, tokenizers, grouping keys/rules and promotion gates. Apply the same normalization to every source URL.
correctness_amendment.problem: Native en.wikipedia.org document URLs use //w/index.php; the committed parser only dispatched /w/index.php.

failure_branches: Source/metadata/tokenizer/helper drift, parser/identity error, wrong counts, forbidden projection or resource-floor violation: fail closed, retain incomplete artifacts; any semantic-independent correctness amendment is preregistered with originals retained.
Insufficient long natural source/group counts: keep result and audit another lawful natural source; no synthetic padding, final-derived tuning or relaxed margins.

Potentially adequate input counts: native annotation/evidence workflow validation, grouping/cross-source overlap, task/metric registry, DEV-only power and evidence-position design remain mandatory before any final model result.
grouping: Connected components join native NFC/underscore-whitespace-normalized casefolded article titles, URL article titles (wiki path or title query, original URL preserved), and exact substantive-text SHA256 identities. Deterministic representative is lexicographically smallest row ID; report any-qualifying-row components and all rows. This is source overlap control, not proof of author/template/user statistical independence. Cross-source and future training overlaps require separate union before evaluation. Normalize only duplicate leading URL-path slashes for route dispatch; preserve the original URL in the ledger.
hypothesis: The full native Natural Questions validation documents may supply a larger natural8192/16384-token source stratum than QASPER; input counts/group counts are unknown before execution.
input_projection: Decode only these nested Parquet columns; exclude document.html, question, long_answer_candidates and annotations. Join source-native token strings whose native is_html flag is false with one ASCII space, retaining original wording/order; no HTML decoding, title duplication, padding, truncation, unrelated concatenation or generated summaries. Counts exclude question/options/framework/special-token overhead.
native_token_layouts: Permit documented logical tokens as a struct of equal-length lists or a list of structs with exactly token/is_html/start_byte/end_byte. Validate native field types, lengths, offsets and ordering; malformed source records fail without selective exclusion.
primary_metric: Per-tokenizer counts of natural substantive source rows/components with>=8192tokens.

promotion_gates.census: Every7830 source row present,7 exact pinned source objects checked before/after, only committed input columns decoded, zero model forwards and original allocation retained.

secondary_metrics: Counts>=512/1024/16384, full min/median/max, exact source-shard row counts/byte identities.
Private per-row IDs/original title+URL/text SHA256/token counts and component membership.
seed: No sampling or random split: all7 pinned validation shards in file-tree order, all7830 source rows.

source.authorized_scope: Bounded local evaluation preparation under the recorded CC BY-SA3.0 dataset-specific grant; no training/shipping/redistribution.

splits: All official validation stays confirmation-only under the neutral allocation policy; this study does not train, select, fit thresholds or calibrate on any of these records. The input-only census is not final model scoring. No train/dev/cal carve from this source. Prior Vey/Laya/backbone exposure remains UNKNOWN.
statistical_test: Deterministic source census only; no model-quality test, paired delta, probability calibration or certification evidence. Input eligibility and source components do not establish effective inferential sample size.
